title: Women pay to break things – level 1
paragraphs: Many women in the UK are visiting new places called rage rooms. In these rooms, people use hammers to break old TVs, plates, and boxes.

People go there because they feel very stressed, tired, or sad about life and work. Owners of these rooms say that most of their visitors are women. Doctors say that it is good to let out bad feelings in a safe space. Men can get angry during sports, but women must be quiet and calm.
Breaking things makes people feel happy and strong for a short time. But it cannot solve big life problems forever.

words.d: a hand tool which we use for breaking things
a person who has something and it belongs to him or her
